title: Cystinuria variant–structure–function evidence atlas
description: Versioned derived data and analysis code for the manuscript “Assay and allele context shape the functional evidence map for cystinuria variants”. Includes 488 VCV records, 105 curated result/condition rows, 19 supplementary tables, source locators, six figures and downstream reproduction scripts. Variant and structure snapshot: 5 October 2026; literature curation through 8 October 2026. Reproduction starts from the frozen derived tables.
